summary: 74-year-old Grand Junction man suffered a life-threatening medical event (trauma not a factor) while climbing Telluride's Via Ferrata with his step-daughter; after completing 'the main event' section ~4 p.m. Saturday he sat on a narrow ledge and became unresponsive; his step-daughter started CPR and called 911; ~45 minutes of resuscitative efforts before he was pronounced dead ~4:45 p.m.; ~12 SAR volunteers executed a five-hour technical recovery mission
location: Telluride Via Ferrata, 'the main event' section, east end of Telluride box canyon
responding_agency: San Miguel County SAR; Telluride Fire Protection District EMS; San Miguel County Sheriff's Office
notes: San Miguel County Sheriff news release (AID=318) dated 2018-09-16, parent-opened this run; incident date = the 'Saturday afternoon' before the Sept 16 release.
